trap.label: in vs of
trap.wrong: He is the fastest of the team.
trap.right: He is the fastest in the team.
trap.why: Em português usamos 'da equipe' (de); em inglês, depois do superlativo usa-se in + grupo/lugar, of + plural.

mcq.q: She is the smartest ___ the class.

fix.wrong: He is the best in all.
fix.right: He is the best of all.

rewrite.prompt: Complete: “She is the ___ (young) in her class.”
rewrite.answer: She is the youngest in her class.
He is the best of all.
